### Rather than starting from scratch i try to manipulate and extract the binary matrix file 
```{r, eval=F}
 library(ComplexHeatmap)
 library(circlize)
 library(dendextend)
 library(dplyr)
 library(readr)
`library(tidyverse)
all_mat_bin <- read.table("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.mat.bin",header=T)%>%
  select(-c(chr,ref))
k13_622I <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/genotype_extraction/k13_target/target_positions_genotypes_k13.csv",header=T)%>%
  filter(grepl("1",genotype))
gondar_eritrea_sample <- read.table("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/flanking_haplotype_updated/k13_gondar_eritrea/gondar_eritrea.txt",header=T)

eritrian_622I <- k13_622I%>%
  filter(grepl("ERR",sample))%>%
  select(sample)%>%
  dplyr:::rename(wgs_id=sample)

gondar_sample_er_622I <- gondar_eritrea_sample%>% # run the first for gondar and eritria 
  filter(grepl("GM",wgs_id))%>%
  full_join(eritrian_622I)
  
# for extracting samples and positions from the binary matrix file
df_filtered <- all_mat_bin[, colnames(all_mat_bin) %in% c("pos",gondar_sample_er_622I$wgs_id)]
filtered_data <- df_filtered[df_filtered$pos >= 1625133 & df_filtered$pos <= 1825133, ] # change this positions for start and end 

```

#### when making the flanking haplotype there are different paramatres or staffs that are changes through out things like the range,sample seletion (which samples to include) and the method of the distance matrix calculation so in this case i use euclidean. There might be differnt clustering due to different parametres for instance when i use different ranges the clustering might be different like the chance of getting varaint on the position is getting higher so there is an  effect on clustering.

```{r, eval=F}

make_flanking_heatmap <- function(
  bin_file,
  target,
  title,
  metadata
) {

  ## -------------------------
  ## Read & prepare matrix
  ## -------------------------
  mat <- bin_file

  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

  df <- as.matrix(mat)
  rownames(df) <- mat$pos
  df <- df[, -1]
  df <- t(df)

  full_data <- data.frame(sample = rownames(df), df, check.names = FALSE)
  full_data[full_data == 0.5] <- 1
  full_data[is.na(full_data)] <- 0
  full_data <- full_data[, colSums(full_data != 0) > 0]

  ## -------------------------
  ## Encode target locus
  ## -------------------------
  full_data[[as.character(target)]] <- ifelse(
    full_data[[as.character(target)]] == 1, 4,
    ifelse(full_data[[as.character(target)]] == 0, 3,
           full_data[[as.character(target)]])
  )

  mat_final <- as.matrix(full_data[, -1])
  rownames(mat_final) <- full_data$sample

  ## -------------------------
  ## Row annotation (metadata)
  ## -------------------------
  metadata_2 <- metadata %>%
    filter(sample %in% rownames(mat_final)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("sample")
  metadata_2 <- metadata_2[rownames(mat_final), , drop = FALSE]

  site_colors <- c(
    "Ethiopia" = "#009E73",
    "Uganda" = "#0072B2",
    "south_east_asia" = "#D55E00",
    "Gondar" = "#009E73",
    "unknown" = "#999999",
    "Eritria" = "#D55E00"
  )

  ha_row <- rowAnnotation(
    site = metadata_2$site,
    col = list(site = site_colors)
  )

  ## -------------------------
  ## Column annotation (target)
  ## -------------------------
  ha_col <- columnAnnotation(
    Target = ifelse(colnames(mat_final) == target, "Target", ""),
    col = list(Target = c("Target" = "red")),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE
  )

  ## -------------------------
  ## Colors
  ## -------------------------
  col_fun <- colorRamp2(
    breaks = c(0, 1, 3, 4),
    colors = c(
      "#F2F2F2",  # REF
      "#2C7FB8",  # ALT
      "#61fdaa",  # Target REF
      "#D7301F"   # Target ALT
    )
  )

  ## -------------------------
  ## Clustering
  ## -------------------------
  #rowcluster <- hclust(dist(mat_final), method = "ward.D2")
  rowcluster <- hclust(dist(mat_final, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")
  # After reordering, verify alignment
  cat("Checking alignment:\n")
  cat("First 5 samples in heatmap:", head(rownames(mat_final)), "\n")
  cat("First 5 samples in metadata:", head(rownames(metadata_2)), "\n")
  cat("Are they identical?", all(rownames(mat_final) == rownames(metadata_2)), "\n")
  ## -------------------------
  ## Heatmap
  ## -------------------------
  Heatmap(
    mat_final,
    name = title,
    col = col_fun,
    cluster_rows = rowcluster,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    left_annotation = ha_row,
    top_annotation = ha_col,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    use_raster = FALSE,
    column_title = paste0("Target: ", target," ","range= 1625133-1825133"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Genotype",
      at = c(0, 1, 3, 4),
      labels = c("REF", "ALT", "Target (REF)", "Target (ALT)")
    )
  )

}


metadata_1 <- gondar_sample_er_622I %>% 
  dplyr:::rename(sample=wgs_id) %>% 
  mutate(site = case_when(
    grepl("GM",sample) ~ "Gondar",
    TRUE ~ "Eritria"
  ))

ht2 <- make_flanking_heatmap(
  bin_file = filtered_data,
  target   = 1725133,
  title    = "K13 622",
  metadata = metadata_1
)
```
